why: The sexy prime conjecture (infinitely many prime pairs differing by 6) remains open; it is a special case of bounded prime gaps equivalent to gap size 6, and current bounded-gap records (H1<=246 from Maynard/Polymath, with a September 2026 preprint improving this to 240) are far from reaching gap 6, so the specific question is untouched. No source claims a proof, disproof, or narrowing that resolves this case.

found.title: Bounded gaps between primes (improved H1 bound to 240)
found.note: Preprint improving the general bounded prime gap bound from 246 to 240; does not address the specific gap-6 (sexy primes) case.
